listing.title: My First Space Coloring Book
listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Outer Space Pages – Rocket, Astronaut, Moon, Planets & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: a first coloring book that blasts off into space!

Little hands color 30 friendly space pictures, from a rocket and an astronaut to the moon, Saturn and a shooting star. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines, so small hands can color inside the lines.

Inside you'll find:

  • In the sky: Moon, Sleepy Moon, Sun, Star, Shooting Star, Comet, Space Rock, Star Picture and Galaxy
  • Planets: Earth, Saturn, Jupiter and Mars
  • Space travel: Rocket, Blast Off, Space Shuttle, Moon Lander, Moon Rover, Satellite, Space Station, Flying Saucer, Telescope and Star Watching House
  • Space friends: Astronaut, Space Helmet, Flag on the Moon, Friendly Alien, Robot, Space Puppy and Space Kitty
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines, and each name in big letters to color
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5.

Part of the my first step series.
